description:
Get detailed information about a specific member.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - user_id (string): Discord user ID
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Member details including username, nickname, roles, join date

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_get_member
title: Get Discord Member
